The Lenovo LOQ 15 with Ryzen 5 150 and RTX 3050 6GB is the entry point of the LOQ gaming lineup — a budget gaming laptop engineered for players who want a genuine RTX-class GPU, DDR5 memory, a 144Hz IPS G-Sync display, and the LOQ platform's build quality at the most accessible price in the LOQ range. With 6GB GDDR6 VRAM addressing the primary limitation of the previous 4GB RTX 3050 generation, and the Ryzen 5 150's 6-core mobile processor providing solid 1080p gaming CPU performance — the LOQ 15 RTX 3050 6GB is the right entry-level gaming choice for budget-conscious buyers who want a complete, serviceable gaming machine.

 

 AMD RYZEN 5 150 — 6 CORES, 12 THREADS, UP TO 4.55GHz

 The AMD Ryzen 5 150 is a mobile processor with 6 cores, 12 threads, 16MB L3 cache, and a 35W configurable TDP — boosting up to 4.55GHz on a single core for responsive single-threaded gaming performance. Based on AMD's mature Zen 3+ architecture manufactured on TSMC's 6nm process, the Ryzen 5 150 delivers efficient, stable gaming CPU performance across the RTX 3050's target frame rate range at 1080p — handling background processes, game logic, and system tasks without CPU bottlenecking the GPU in the gaming workload scenarios the RTX 3050 is designed for.

 

 Note: The Ryzen 5 150 uses Zen 3+ architecture and does not include a dedicated NPU (Neural Processing Unit) — it is not an AI-accelerated Copilot+ platform. The "AI-Powered" label in some listings refers to platform-level software features rather than dedicated on-chip AI inference hardware.

 The RTX 3050 6GB is the Ada-class entry-level laptop GPU upgrade from NVIDIA's Ada Lovelace generation — and critically, it ships with 6GB GDDR6 VRAM rather than the 4GB of the original RTX 3050 Laptop GPU. This matters:

 

 6GB GDDR6 VRAM addresses the primary limitation of the previous 4GB variant — 4GB fills up quickly in today's games like Cyberpunk 2077, The Last of Us Part I, and Hogwarts Legacy, leading to data swapping with RAM and causing stutters and frame drops. 6GB provides the necessary buffer to use medium or higher texture settings at 1080p without crossing critical VRAM limits.

 

 At 1080p, the RTX 3050 6GB targets:

 - Esports and competitive titles (Valorant, CS2, Fortnite, Apex Legends): 100+ FPS at High-Ultra settings

 - Mid-range AAA titles (GTA V, Elden Ring, God of War): 40–60 FPS at Medium-High settings

 - Minecraft, Roblox, indie titles: high frame rates with minimal GPU load

 

 DLSS 2 (Super Resolution) is supported — enabling AI-powered upscaling that boosts frame rates at quality levels close to native resolution in DLSS-supported titles, extending the RTX 3050 6GB's effective performance ceiling above its raw rasterisation output.

 

 G-SYNC — SMOOTH, TEAR-FREE 144Hz GAMING

 The LOQ 15's 144Hz IPS panel supports G-Sync — eliminating the screen tearing and micro-stuttering that occurs when the RTX 3050 6GB's output frame rate fluctuates below or above the panel's refresh rate. In competitive esports titles where the RTX 3050 6GB produces consistent high frame rates, G-Sync maintains tear-free, smooth output across the full 144Hz range — critical for fast-paced competitive play.

The Lenovo LOQ 15 with Core i5-13450HX and RTX 4050 6GB is the value flagship of the LOQ lineup — delivering a 105W RTX 4050 at full performance TGP, a 10-core Intel HX-series processor, Lenovo AI Engine+ with the LA1 AI chip, MUX Switch with Advanced Optimus, 16GB DDR5, a 144Hz IPS G-Sync display, and Hyperchamber thermal design — all at the LOQ's accessible mid-range price point. For buyers stepping up from the entry Ryzen 5 150 RTX 3050 6GB configuration, the i5-13450HX RTX 4050 105W delivers a meaningful GPU performance increase alongside a significantly more capable 10-core Intel HX CPU.

 

 INTEL CORE i5-13450HX — 10 CORES, 16 THREADS, UP TO 4.60GHz

 The i5-13450HX is a 13th Generation Raptor Lake HX-series processor with 6 Performance cores (P-cores) boosting to 4.60GHz and 4 Efficiency cores (E-cores) running to 3.40GHz across 10 cores, 16 threads, 20MB L3 cache, and a 55W TDP. The HX platform feeds the RTX 4050 at full 105W TGP under combined CPU-GPU gaming load without CPU bottlenecking — a critical advantage over lower-power H-series and U-series alternatives that cannot sustain peak GPU power delivery alongside their own processing demands.

 

 LENOVO AI ENGINE+ WITH LA1 AI CHIP — HARDWARE AI ACCELERATION

 The Lenovo AI Engine+ integrates the proprietary Lenovo LA1 AI chip alongside the i5-13450HX CPU — a dedicated hardware accelerator that dynamically monitors and boosts system performance in real time based on workload type and thermal conditions:

 - Intelligently shifts power allocation between CPU and GPU based on the active workload — prioritising GPU power during GPU-bound gaming scenes and CPU power during CPU-intensive moments

 - Works in combination with the MUX Switch and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus for performance optimisation beyond standard power delivery

 - Optimises fan speed and thermal management proactively rather than reactively

 The LA1 AI chip distinguishes the i5-13450HX LOQ from competing gaming laptops at the same price tier that rely on software-only performance management.

 

 MUX SWITCH + ADVANCED OPTIMUS — DIRECT GPU OUTPUT

 The MUX Switch enables the display to connect directly to the RTX 4050 — bypassing the integrated Intel graphics and eliminating the 10–15% frame rate penalty of standard Optimus configurations. Toggle MUX Switch mode via Lenovo Vantage for maximum performance during gaming, or enable Advanced Optimus for battery-efficient everyday use. The combination of MUX Switch + LA1 AI chip + 105W TGP represents the LOQ's full performance stack.

 

 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 LAPTOP GPU — 6GB GDDR6, 105W TGP, 2370MHz BOOST

 The RTX 4050 6GB GDDR6 operates at 105W TGP — the maximum configurable power envelope for the RTX 4050 Laptop GPU. At 105W with 2370MHz boost clock and 6GB GDDR6 VRAM, real-world 1080p gaming targets:

 - Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2: 144+ FPS at High-Ultra — fully utilising the 144Hz G-Sync panel

 - Elden Ring, God of War, Spider-Man Remastered: 60-80+ FPS at High settings

 - Cyberpunk 2077 (DLSS Quality): 60+ FPS at 1080p High

 - GTA V: 100+ FPS at Very High settings

 

 DLSS 3 (Frame Generation) — note: DLSS 3 Frame Generation is supported on Ada Lovelace architecture. Confirm DLSS 3 Frame Generation availability per title via NVIDIA's supported games list. DLSS 3 Super Resolution is supported across all compatible titles.

 

 HYPERCHAMBER THERMAL DESIGN — DUAL FAN + EXTRA 10W IN EXTREME MODE

 Hyperchamber thermal design features dual fans spinning outward, expelling heat efficiently from the rear end, and a sealed chamber that grants an extra 10W of power in Extreme Mode, reduces skin temperature, and minimises noise. The Hyperchamber's additional 10W power overhead in Extreme Mode pushes the RTX 4050 beyond its standard TGP ceiling under optimal thermal conditions — delivering incremental frame rate gains during peak gaming sessions.

compume-x32akh.description:
The Lenovo LOQ 15 is a purpose-built gaming laptop engineered for players who demand genuine mid-range GPU performance, a high-TGP RTX 4050 at 105W, and reliable build quality — without the premium price of flagship gaming hardware. Powered by the Intel Core i7-13645HX with 14 cores and 4.90GHz boost, the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU at 105W TGP, 16GB DDR5-4800, a 512GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD, a 144Hz IPS display with G-Sync, and a full port suite including HDMI 2.1 and USB-C PD 140W — the Lenovo LOQ 15 delivers the essentials for 1080p gaming without compromise.

 

 INTEL CORE i7-13645HX — 14 CORES, 20 THREADS, UP TO 4.90GHz

 The i7-13645HX is a 13th Generation Raptor Lake HX-series processor with 6 Performance cores (P-cores) boosting to 4.90GHz and 8 Efficiency cores (E-cores) across 14 cores, 20 threads, and 24MB L3 cache. The HX platform operates at 55W base TDP — providing significantly more sustained CPU performance than H-series (45W) and standard U-series (15W) alternatives in CPU-intensive gaming and multitasking scenarios:

 - Gaming titles that are CPU-bound or require strong background process management benefit directly from the i7-13645HX's 14-core thread count

 - Simultaneous game streaming, Discord, browser sessions, and background downloads are handled without CPU bottlenecking the GPU

 - Creative workloads — video editing, game capture, 3D rendering — complete faster with the HX-class sustained clock speeds

 

 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 LAPTOP GPU — 6GB GDDR6, 105W TGP, 2370MHz BOOST

 The RTX 4050 Laptop GPU in the Lenovo LOQ 15 operates at 105W TGP — the highest power envelope available for the RTX 4050 Laptop configuration. TGP (Total Graphics Power) directly determines gaming performance: a 105W RTX 4050 delivers measurably higher frame rates than the same GPU at 65W or 80W found in thinner, lower-powered competitors. At 105W with 2370MHz boost clock, the RTX 4050 achieves:

 - 1080p High-to-Ultra settings in AAA titles: Cyberpunk 2077 (DLSS Quality), Elden Ring, God of War, Spider-Man Remastered

 - Stable 100+ FPS at 1080p in competitive titles: Valorant, CS2, Fortnite, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2

 - DLSS 3 (Frame Generation) support for AI-powered frame rate boost in supported titles

 - Ray Tracing support (DX12 Ultimate): hardware RT for supported games at 1080p with DLSS

 

 6GB GDDR6 VRAM: the RTX 4050's 6GB GDDR6 frame buffer is adequate for 1080p gaming at high-to-ultra texture settings in all current AAA titles — handling modern game assets, high-resolution texture packs, and ray-traced shadow buffers without VRAM overflow at the target 1080p resolution.

 

 G-SYNC — SMOOTH, TEAR-FREE 144Hz GAMING

 The LOQ 15's IPS display supports NVIDIA G-Sync — dynamically synchronising the 144Hz panel's refresh rate to the RTX 4050's output frame rate to eliminate screen tearing and micro-stuttering. Unlike V-Sync (which introduces input latency) or no sync (which produces tearing at frame rate mismatches), G-Sync provides consistently smooth, tear-free output across the RTX 4050's full operating frame rate range — from GPU-limited scenes at 60fps up to the panel's 144Hz ceiling.

 

 15.6" FHD IPS G-SYNC DISPLAY — 144Hz, 300 NITS, 100% sRGB

 - 1920×1080 FHD: native 1080p — the optimal resolution for RTX 4050 gaming, maximising frame rates without the GPU overhead of 1440p or 4K

 - 144Hz: 144 frames-per-second ceiling — significantly smoother than standard 60Hz panels for fast-paced gaming, character movement, and cursor tracking

 - IPS panel: wide viewing angle consistency and accurate colour reproduction — superior to TN panels at competitive price tiers

 - 300 nits: sufficient brightness for standard indoor and darkened gaming room environments

 - 100% sRGB: accurate colour coverage for gaming visuals and content creation

 - Anti-glare coating: reflection reduction for indoor gaming environments

 - Thin bezel: maximised screen presence within the 15.6" chassis footprint

Get lost in the game and upgrade your display game with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRH8 laptop.

 
 

 
 Dominate with ergonomic precision and accuracy

With classic tactile touch-feel and 1.5mm key travel, you'll enjoy lightning-fast actuation and 100% anti-ghosting for unmatched accuracy. The full-sized arrow keys and number pad help you stay in control in any scenario. Plus, the optional 4-zone RGB backlighting lets you add some gaming sauce to your setup.

The Lenovo LOQ 15 with RTX 5050 is NVIDIA Blackwell-generation gaming in the LOQ lineup — combining the next-generation GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU with 8GB GDDR7 memory, DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation, 440 AI TOPS, and a 100W TGP with the proven Intel Core i7-13650HX HX-series platform, MUX Switch with Advanced Optimus, a 5MP webcam, and a 144Hz IPS G-Sync display. The step-up from the RTX 4050 LOQ delivers a generational GPU architecture upgrade, faster GDDR7 VRAM, and substantially higher AI-accelerated frame rates for players who want Blackwell's next-generation capabilities at the LOQ's accessible price point.

 

 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 LAPTOP GPU — BLACKWELL, 8GB GDDR7, DLSS 4

 The RTX 5050 is powered by NVIDIA's Blackwell GPU architecture — the successor to Ada Lovelace (RTX 40 series) — on the GB207 chip with 2,560 CUDA cores, 8GB GDDR7 VRAM on a 128-bit bus running at 24 Gbps. Key advantages over the RTX 4050:

 

 8GB GDDR7 VRAM running at 24 Gbps — GDDR7 memory can be up to 2× more energy efficient than GDDR6, helping deliver more VRAM headroom for modern game assets, higher-resolution textures, and ray-traced frame buffers at 1080p, while the additional 2GB over the RTX 4050's 6GB directly extends longevity as game VRAM requirements increase.

 

 DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation — GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPUs are 2.4× faster on average in raster FPS and consistently more than 4× faster utilising DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, compared to RTX 3050 Laptop GPUs. DLSS 4's Multi Frame Generation generates up to three additional AI-rendered frames for every native frame — filling the 144Hz display with smooth, responsive output in supported titles at frame rates that raw rasterisation alone cannot achieve.

 

 440 AI TOPS AI performance thanks to the built-in Tensor cores — the RTX 5050's fifth-generation Tensor Cores accelerate DLSS 4, NVIDIA Broadcast, and all AI-accelerated application workloads including real-time noise cancellation, background replacement, and AI-enhanced image sharpening.

 

 100W TGP — BALANCED POWER FOR GAMING PERFORMANCE

 The RTX 5050 in this Lenovo LOQ 15 configuration operates at 100W TGP — the standard power envelope for the RTX 5050 in a 15.6" gaming chassis, providing balanced performance for 1080p gaming without the thermal compromises of higher-TGP configurations in thinner chassis. Real-world gaming performance targets at 100W:

 - Valorant, CS2, Apex Legends: 144+ FPS consistently at 1080p

 - Cyberpunk 2077 (DLSS 4 Quality): 60-90+ FPS at 1080p High

 - Elden Ring, Spider-Man Remastered: 60-80+ FPS at 1080p High-Ultra

 - DLSS 4 Multi Frame Generation active: frame rate multiplier above native raster output in supported titles

 

 MUX SWITCH + ADVANCED OPTIMUS — DIRECT GPU OUTPUT FOR MAXIMUM PERFORMANCE

 The LOQ 15 RTX 5050 includes a MUX Switch with Advanced Optimus — enabling the display to connect directly to the RTX 5050 Laptop GPU rather than routing through the integrated Intel graphics. Direct GPU output eliminates the performance loss (typically 10–15% frame rate reduction) that occurs when frames are routed through the iGPU on standard Optimus configurations. Toggle the MUX Switch in Lenovo Vantage to activate direct GPU mode for maximum gaming performance, or enable Optimus for battery-efficient everyday use.

 

 INTEL CORE i7-13650HX — 14 CORES, 20 THREADS, UP TO 4.90GHz

 The i7-13650HX is a 13th Generation Raptor Lake HX-series processor with 6 P-cores and 8 E-cores across 14 cores, 20 threads, and 24MB L3 cache — operating at 55W base TDP. The HX platform provides the sustained CPU headroom to consistently feed the RTX 5050 at 100W without CPU bottlenecking in demanding gaming and multitasking scenarios. The i7-13650HX's built-in Intel AI Boost VPU adds on-device AI inference capability alongside the RTX 5050's 440 AI TOPS for combined CPU + GPU AI workloads.

 More about ASUS ROG Strix G814JVR i9-14900HX 

 

 POWER UP YOUR PLAY

 Draw more frames and win more games with the Strix G18 powered by a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ Processors and NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 40 Series Laptop GPUs. With PCIe® Gen 4×4 SSD storage and 5200 MHz DDR5 RAM, large game libraries and intense multitasking sessions are a breeze for this gaming machine.

 

 
 MUX SWITCH WITH NVIDIA® ADVANCED OPTIMUS

 A GPU MUX switch lets the GPU route frames directly to the display, increasing performance and decreasing latency. Without a MUX switch, the GPU is forced to go through the CPU’s integrated graphics first before reaching the display, which hurts gaming performance. With Advanced Optimus enabled, the system can automatically switch between GPU modes based on the task to optimize performance and battery life.

 

 
 GEFORCE RTX™ 40 SERIES LAPTOPS

 Beyond Fast NVIDIA® GeForce RTX 40 Series Laptop GPUs power the world’s fastest laptops for gamers and creators. Built with the ultra-efficient NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture, they deliver a quantum leap in performance with Al-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the Max-Q suite of technologies optimizes system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.

compume-1bbcq4q.description: The Dell Precision 7680 is a 16-inch mobile workstation built for professional workloads that benefit from high-performance processing and dedicated workstation graphics. This DELL-PRE-7680 configuration combines the 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13850HX vPro processor with 32 GB DDR5 memory and an NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU with 6 GB GDDR6 dedicated memory. A 512 GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe SSD provides fast local storage, while the 16-inch FHD+ 1920 x 1200 anti-glare display offers a productivity-focused 16:10 workspace. Windows 11 Pro and a broad selection of Thunderbolt 4, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, Ethernet and SD card connectivity make the Precision 7680 suitable for demanding professional workstation environments. Key Features 13th Gen Intel Core i7: Core i7-13850HX vPro processor with 20 cores, 28 threads and up to 5.3 GHz Turbo frequency. Professional NVIDIA Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU with 6 GB dedicated GDDR6 memory. 32 GB DDR5 Memory: High-capacity system memory for professional applications and multitasking. 512 GB NVMe SSD: M.2 PCIe Gen4 solid-state storage for fast application and proje access. 16-inch FHD+ Display: 1920 x 1200 WVA anti-glare panel with 60 Hz refresh rate and 16:10 aspe ratio. Workstation Connectivity: Dual Thunderbolt 4, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI 2.1, RJ-45 Ethernet and SD card connectivity. Technical Specifications Component Specification Dell Model Precision 7680 Produ ID DELL-PRE-7680 Produ Type Mobile Workstation Operating System Windows 11 Pro Processor 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13850HX vPro CPU Cores / Threads 20 Cores (8 P-Cores + 12 E-Cores) / 28 Threads Max Turbo Frequency Up to 5.3 GHz Processor Cache 30 MB Processor Power 55 W Integrated Graphics Intel UHD Graphics Discrete Graphics NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU Graphics Memory 6 GB GDDR6 Dedicated Memory 32 GB DDR5 Storage 512 GB M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe SSD Display Size 16-inch Display Resolution FHD+ 1920 x 1200 Panel Technology Wide-Viewing Angle (WVA) Display Surface Anti-Glare Refresh Rate 60 Hz Touchscreen Non-Touch Thunderbolt 2 x Thunderbolt 4 USB-C, Up to 40 Gbps Additional USB-C 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode USB-A 2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1, Including 1 with PowerShare HDMI HDMI 2.1 with Discrete Graphics Ethernet 1 x RJ-45 Gigabit Ethernet Card Reader SD Card Slot Audio Port Universal Audio Jack Security Slot Wedge-Shaped Security Slot Dimensions 356 x 258.34 x 22.30–23.20 mm Weight 2.60 kg Compatibility & Important Information This listing is specifically for produ ID DELL-PRE-7680 with Intel Core i7-13850HX vPro, 32 GB memory, 512 GB SSD, NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada 6 GB, 16-inch FHD+ display and Windows 11 Pro. Dell offered more than one 16-inch FHD+ panel for the Precision 7680. Both official FHD+ options are 1920 x 1200, WVA, anti-glare, non-touch and 60 Hz; brightness and color-gamut figures are therefore not added to this listing. The Precision 7680 platform supports both CAMM and SODIMM DDR5 memory architectures. Memory upgrade requirements depend on the memory interface installed in the system. The NVIDIA RTX 1000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU is a discrete graphics option with 6 GB GDDR6 memory. With discrete graphics installed, the HDMI output operates as HDMI 2.1. The chassis includes two Thunderbolt 4 USB-C ports, one additional USB-C port with DisplayPort Alt Mode, two USB-A ports, RJ-45 Ethernet and an SD card slot.
